'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Character skills#Physical|Physical skill]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Immunity affects the susceptibility to illnesses and the effectiveness of their treatment.

==Effects==
* Reduces all negative effects from stimulants, food, water (1% per level → +50% at Elite Level)
* Reduces poison effect force (1% per level → +50% at Elite Level)
* Increases painkiller action time (0.6% per level → +30% at Elite Level)
* <font color="#c78b2c">Elite level</font>: Chance to gain immunity to negative effects from stimulants, food, water (+90%)
* <font color="#c78b2c">Elite level</font>: Chance to gain immunity to poisons (+90%)

==How to raise==
* Using and surviving the negative effects of [[Stimulants]] and [[Provisions]]
* Completing the quest [[Crisis]]
* Completing the quest [[The Huntsman Path - Relentless]]
* Completing the quest [[Get a Foothold]]

==Leveling Guide==
* Skill points are awarded at the end of a [[File:Stim debuff.png|33px|Debuff]] period, not during. It can get prolonged by consuming multiple items.
** The amount and types of negative effects do not influence the points gain. The points gain solely depends on the negative effect duration.
** [[Metabolism]] reduces the duration of negative effects, which makes long-lasting [[Medical|injectors and stimulants]] give less points but safer to use.
** Per 1 second of negative effect duration you gain ~0.0045 points.
** Extracting from a raid ends the [[File:Stim debuff.png|33px|Debuff]] period, giving points only for the duration of the effect up to that point.
* [[Can of Max Energy energy drink]] has a minor 5-minute [[Stress Resistance|stress resistance]] debuff, so drinking one every 5 minutes is a cost-effective way to gain skill points.
* [[2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector]] has a 15-minute hydration debuff, make sure to bring extra [[Provisions|drinks]].
* [[Obdolbos 2 cocktail injector]] has multiple 30-minute debuffs, including a health points one, make sure to bring extra [[Medical|meds]].
